about: Wruck Paupore publishes three attorneys, two founding partners and one of counsel, and offices in Dyer, South Bend and West Lafayette, describing a practice that reaches Indiana, Illinois, Michigan and Wisconsin.

It calls its fee terms a Zero Fee Promise and runs a 24 hour helpline. It holds the highest review average of any firm in this market, 4.94 across 122 reviews, and it publishes no case results with amounts we could read.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Indiana does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Indiana on the discipline of Indiana attorneys, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 301 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Indiana on the discipline of Indiana attorneys, 1960 to 2026. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Indiana publishes no business register we can query. INBiz answers an automated reader with a 403 and the Secretary of State's business search answers with a 202 and an empty body, which is a bot challenge, and we do not work around either. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 3 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 122 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2006-06-21, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP
